_readme: SparkConnect kill switch. Edit this file, redeploy the website, and the change reaches every installed app within hours — no App Store review. Safety behaviour (refusals, disclaimers, the authority boundary) is NOT remotely disableable; the app ignores any attempt to switch those off.
_howToDisableAFeature: Add the feature id under "features" with "disabled": true. Ids: SPARK_AI, VOICE_ASK, CALCULATOR, TROUBLESHOOT, WIRING_LESSON, JOBSITE, BLUEPRINT, JOB_CAM, PERMIT, CONTRACTOR_CONNECT.
